name: Mikva Student Election Judge Program
org: Mikva Challenge Illinois with Chicago election officials
what_you_do: High school juniors and seniors work at polling places on Election Day. They do the same jobs as adult judges. They help voters, run the machines and close the polls.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors in Chicago. Mikva staff recruit through teachers.
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the program page. Ask Mikva Challenge.
duration: One election day, before the polls open until after they close
deadline_text: Each election cycle. No dates posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Ask your teacher or school about Mikva Challenge student election judges. Or write to inquiries@mikvachallenge.org. You can also call (312) 863-6340.
notes: Mikva says it recruits 2,000+ juniors and seniors in Chicago and DC each election cycle. Mikva says it works with local election boards. The Chicago Board of Election Commissioners website blocked our reader, so pay, age and sign-up rules there were not checked. Confirm with Mikva or the Board.
